name: China
sources: No per-nation sourcing note existed when this nation was first entered in init.rs; the table header recorded only "Transcribed-not-invented: approximate 1990 historical starting conditions".
Figures below are transcribed unchanged from that table. Their origin was not documented at the time and is a known gap in provenance.

pop_growth_1990 = 1.5308%/yr. Compound annual growth of World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, series CHN (China): 1,036,825,000 in 1984 to 1,118,650,000 in 1989 — the five years ending on the eve of the 1 January 1990 start date. See EconomyRecord::pop_growth_1990 in spheres-sim/src/data/mod.rs for why the window ends in 1989 and not with the single-year 1990 rate.

reserves_bn = 23.053 ($bn). Total reserves including gold, CHN, 1989: US$23052566323.23 (World Bank World Development Indicators series FI.RES.TOTL.CD, 'Total reserves (includes gold, current US$)', retrieved from the World Bank API on 2026-09-02; indicator lastupdated 2026-07-13). THE 1989 OBSERVATION AND NOT THE 1990 ONE: a reserve is a stock, and the stock on the morning of the 1 January 1990 start date is the end-1989 figure - the same reasoning pop_growth_1990 above gives for ending its window on 31 December 1989. LIMIT STATED: this series is official reserve assets. Sovereign wealth fund balances are not in it and none has been added, because no audited 1990 balance could be sourced for any of them; where that materially understates a state's usable stock it is reported rather than estimated (iron rule 4).

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 5 were held and are listed below with their citations; 43 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_cmos_submicron, core_packet_internetworking, core_single_mode_fiber, core_carbon_composites, core_combined_cycle_turbine, core_pcr, comp_microprocessor, comp_risc_superscalar, comp_relational_database, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_horizontal_drilling, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, ener_crystalline_silicon_module, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_composite_structures, matl_industrial_robotics, matl_lean_production, matl_single_crystal_superalloy, matl_stereolithography, aero_precision_munitions, aero_pulse_doppler_radar, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_quiet_submarine, aero_recon_satellite, bio_recombinant_pharma, bio_oral_rehydration, bio_cross_sectional_imaging, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_monoclonal_antibody, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, tran_electronic_freight_documents, tran_high_speed_rail, agri_drip_irrigation, agri_composite_membrane, agri_conservation_tillage, agri_integrated_pest_management, agri_protected_cultivation, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

granted.source: China's first program-controlled digital exchange, a Fujitsu F-150 of 10,000 lines, was contracted on 24 December 1980, installed at Fuzhou on 12 April 1982 and cut into service at 00:00 on 27 November 1982. Production of ITT System 12 digital exchanges began at the Shanghai Bell joint venture in 1985 - the first advanced digital switching system produced in the PRC (UPI, 14 October 1985).

Dong Fang Hong 2, China's first geostationary communications satellite, was developed at the Chinese Academy of Space Technology and successfully placed in geosynchronous orbit on 8 April 1984, making the PRC the fifth country able to launch a spacecraft into geostationary transfer orbit independently. It carried CCTV to Urumqi and Lhasa. Chinese design, Chinese manufacture, Chinese launch.
China's NMT network opened in 1986 (Nordic Mobile Telephone country launch record). World Bank WDI IT.CEL.SETS records 18,319 Chinese mobile cellular subscriptions in 1990.

San Huan, the Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Physics venture founded in the mid-1980s, produced sintered NdFeB on Baotou rare-earth supply. MODERATE: the founding year and the 1990 output scale are not pinned, and the grant is for use, which production entails.

WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 coverage, China, 1990: 97% — seven points above the United States, and the product of the Ministry of Health's Expanded Programme on Immunization delivered through the barefoot-doctor and county epidemic-prevention station network. Series: WUENIC DTP3 ('China,CHN,1990,97').
